encoding: UTF-8 JSON; field elements as canonical decimal strings; indices zero-based

template.variables: 7 selectors per block in block-major order then m-2 unrestricted intermediate U variables
template.columns: generator-major, then lexicographic pairs a<=b excluding a=b<7m
template.monomial: Sorted list of six variable indices; repeated selectors reduce to zero, U exponents unrestricted
template.pivot_rows: Original coefficient row [column,decimal coefficient], monomial, pivot column and nonzero pre-normalization pivot
template.replay: Reconstruct all original coefficients and deterministic sparse Gaussian elimination; reported rank alone is insufficient

coverage.construction: For every local pair i<=j, pad {i,j} with smallest missing indices to seven, then deduplicate
coverage.validation: Every ordered pair in0..26 x0..26 covered by at least one subset; every U retained
coverage.purpose: Coefficient restrictions of original27-selector system, not replacement factor bases

bounds.success: Full rank plus source normalization and pair-cover proof implies FFD>=7
bounds.deficiency: Inconclusive for original system; no lifted kernel claimed

development_summary: validation-prime-quadratic-development/summary.json; layout fields are exact domain dimensions, not measured ranks or memory bounds
